title: Regulation of macrophage phenotypes via NF-kappaB/NLRP3 and HIF1alpha/p53 pathways by fuco-galactoglucan from Agrocybe aegerita.
authors: Li, Xiaojun; Shui, Menglin; Zhang, Xue; Tang, Huizi; Guo, Haiyang; Gu, Feng; Xu, Hairong; Han, Baowei; Kou, Yu
one_liner_zh: 研究多糖调节巨噬细胞极化及抗结直肠癌机制，涉及NF-kB/NLRP3和HIF1a/p53通路，仅含分子对接但非蛋白-DNA互作核心，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Agrocybe aegerita polysaccharides (AAP), known for their diverse pharmacological properties, have yet to be fully understood in terms of their structure evaluation, effects and mechanisms on tumor-associated macrophages in colorectal cancer. Agrocybe aegerita polysaccharides were extracted using hot water and subsequently purified. Their structure was elucidated through methylation and nuclear magnetic resonance analyses. The impact of AAP-0.2A on macrophage polarization was assessed using flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, and ELISA. Furthermore, transcriptomics, molecular docking and western blot were employed to investigate the specific mechanisms by which AAP-0.2A influence macrophage polarization. Conditioned media were applied to CT26 cells to evaluate the effects on the proliferation and apoptosis of colorectal cancer cells. These findings demonstrate that AAP-0.2A are neutral fuco-galactoglucans that increased M1 phenotype markers of CD86, CCR7, IFN-gamma while decreased M2 phenotype markers of CD206, Arg1 and IL-10. They enhance M1 macrophage polarization by activating the NF-kappaB/NLRP3 and HIF1A/P53 pathways. Further studies have shown that AAP-0.2A inhibit the proliferation and induce apoptosis of colorectal cancer cells, counteracting the effects of IL-4-conditioned media. These results suggested that AAP-0.2A repolarized macrophages from M2 to M1 phenotype through activating NF-kappaB/NLRP3 and HIF-1alpha/p53 pathways to inhibit the proliferation and induce apoptosis of colorectal cancer cells.
abstract_zh: 杨树菇多糖（Agrocybe aegerita polysaccharides, AAP）以其多样的药理特性而闻名，但其在结直肠癌中对肿瘤相关巨噬细胞的结构评估、作用及机制尚未完全阐明。采用热水提取杨树菇多糖，随后进行纯化。通过甲基化和核磁共振分析阐明其结构。使用流式细胞术、免疫荧光和ELISA评估AAP-0.2A对巨噬细胞极化的影响。此外，采用转录组学、分子对接和蛋白质印迹法研究AAP-0.2A影响巨噬细胞极化的具体机制。将条件培养基应用于CT26细胞，以评估其对结直肠癌细胞增殖和凋亡的影响。研究结果表明，AAP-0.2A为中性岩藻半乳葡聚糖，可增加M1表型标志物CD86、CCR7、IFN-γ的表达，同时降低M2表型标志物CD206、Arg1和IL-10的表达。它们通过激活NF-κB/NLRP3和HIF1A/P53通路增强M1巨噬细胞极化。进一步研究表明，AAP-0.2A抑制结直肠癌细胞增殖并诱导其凋亡，抵消IL-4条件培养基的作用。这些结果表明，AAP-0.2A通过激活NF-κB/NLRP3和HIF-1α/p53通路，将巨噬细胞从M2表型重新极化为M1表型，从而抑制结直肠癌细胞增殖并诱导其凋亡。
